subject: Next steps: technical deep dive & 2-week trial orchestration
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Megan Cole <megan.cole@healthgrid.ai>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps: technical deep dive & 2-week trial orchestration

Hi Megan — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

- Goal: run a focused 2-week evaluation to validate inference latency/throughput and answer prompt quality questions against a small production prompt set.
- Proposed success criteria (draft):
  * 95th pct latency for 512-token avg prompt < 400ms (p50 < 120ms)
  * End-to-end throughput to support ~10 concurrent sessions at target SLA
  * Quality: top-1 answer correctness > 85% on your 50-case prompt set (we'll formalize evaluation harness)

Next meeting: technical deep dive / integration planning (30–45m) — I'll have Sergio (solutions) and Ben (customer success) join. Please pick one of these slots (all PT):
  • Wed Mar 23, 10:00–10:45am
  • Thu Mar 24, 2:00–2:45pm
  • Fri Mar 25, 9:00–9:45am

Prework for the deep dive:
- Share a redacted sample prompt set (50–100 prompts) and representative input sizes
- Any constraints on hosting / VPC / data residency
- Your security questionnaire (we'll do a quick pass)

I've attached a one-pager trial plan for your review (redwood_trial_plan_v1.pdf) and a draft agenda. If those slots don't work, tell me a few windows and we'll adjust.

Thanks — looking forward.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0193
